# AllianceMiddleman (Sigo API)

> Self-drive car rental platform backend for Vietnam market.
> Connects vehicle Owners with Renters through a managed marketplace.

## System Identity

- Name: AllianceMiddleman (commercial: Sigo API)
- URL: https://api.sigo.vn
- Tech: ASP.NET Core 5.0, EF Core 5.0, SQL Server + PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, SignalR, Docker
- Language: C#, Vietnamese UI strings
- Deploy: Docker multi-stage, Jenkins CI/CD

## Architecture (4-Layer)

```
[1] AllianceMiddlemanWebAPI        — Controllers, JWT Auth, SignalR Hub, Compression
[2] AllianceMiddlemanWebAPI.Service — Business Logic, Validation, 29+ Background Engines
[3] AllianceMiddlemanWebAPI.Core    — EF Core, DbContext, 17 Stored Procedures
[4] AllianceMiddlemanWebAPI.DataShared — Shared DTOs between layers
    Modules: Ezy.Module.EWallet, Identity, CMS, DynamicReport, TrafficTicket, Hotline
```

## Key Conventions

| Pattern | Details |
|---------|---------|
| Response wrapper | `EzyResultObject<T>` — Status: 1=OK, 0=Error, -1=ServerError, -2=Unauthorized |
| Paginated list | `EzyDataSourceResult<T>` — Data[] + TotalCount |
| Entity base | `IEFBaseEntity` — Id (long), IsDeleted, Log_CreatedDate/By, Log_UpdatedDate/By |
| Service factory | `CreateServiceInstance<T>()` — NOT standard DI, factory pattern |
| Cache system | `CachedDataManagement` — 70+ config tables cached in-memory |
| Background jobs | Custom `Ezy.Module.Engine.dll` framework, NOT Hangfire |
| ID format | `long` in DB, `string` in API models (auto-converted) |
| Timezone | DB stores UTC; client sends `UI_TimezoneOffset=-420` (VN=UTC+7) |

## Order Status Machine (9 statuses)

```
NEW → OWNER2CONFIRM → CUS2DEPOSIT → WAITING2CONFIRMDEPOSIT → WAITING2DEPARTURE → INTHETRIP → DONE
         ↓                ↓                   ↓                      ↓
    SYSTEMCANCEL     CUSCANCEL           CUSCANCEL              CUSCANCEL
    OWNERCANCEL      OWNERCANCEL         OWNERCANCEL            OWNERCANCEL
    CUSCANCEL        SYSTEMCANCEL
```

Cancelable: {OWNER2CONFIRM, CUS2DEPOSIT, WAITING2CONFIRMDEPOSIT, WAITING2DEPARTURE}
Terminal: {DONE, CUSCANCEL, OWNERCANCEL, SYSTEMCANCEL}
Auto-complete: INTHETRIP → DONE after ToDate + 60 minutes

## Pricing Pipeline (condensed)

```
1. GetRentalDaySegments()      → Split rental into Early/FullDay/Late segments
2. GetOriginalPrice()          → Sum segment prices (DatePrice > WeekdayPrice > BasePrice)
3. GetPriceByDay()             → Apply multiday discount, voucher
4. TotalPrice = SubTotal + InsuranceFee + DeliveryFee - DiscountMoney
5. DepositAmount = TotalPrice × 30% (or fixed amount)
6. PlanProfitAmount = SubTotal × CompletionFee% + ServiceFee - DiscountMoney
7. OwnerRemainAmount = DepositAmount - PlanProfitAmount - InsuranceFee - WithholdingTax
```

### Worked Example — Thuê xe 3 ngày

```
Input:  Toyota Vios, Hà Nội, 10/03 08:00 → 12/03 20:00
        BasePrice = 650,000 VND/ngày, không có DatePrice/WeekdayPrice override
        InsuranceFee = 35,000/ngày, DeliveryFee = 50,000, Voucher = 10% (max 200,000)
        CompletionFee = 25%, ServiceFee = 30,000, WithholdingTax = 0

Step 1: GetRentalDaySegments()
  → [FullDay 10/03, FullDay 11/03, Late 12/03 (=1 full day vì ≥12h)]
  → 3 full days

Step 2: GetOriginalPrice()
  → 3 × 650,000 = 1,950,000

Step 3: GetPriceByDay()
  → SubTotal = 1,950,000
  → DiscountMoney = min(1,950,000 × 10%, 200,000) = 195,000

Step 4: TotalPrice = 1,950,000 + 105,000 + 50,000 - 195,000 = 1,910,000
Step 5: DepositAmount = 1,910,000 × 30% = 573,000
Step 6: PlanProfitAmount = 1,950,000 × 25% + 30,000 - 195,000 = 322,500
Step 7: OwnerRemainAmount = 573,000 - 322,500 - 105,000 - 0 = 145,500

→ Renter trả cọc: 573,000 VND
→ Platform giữ: 322,500 VND
→ Owner nhận: 145,500 VND (tạm, nhận thêm phần còn lại khi hoàn thành)
```

## Business Rules Quick Reference

| Rule | Value | Source |
|------|-------|--------|
| Default deposit | 30% of TotalPrice | `RentalServiceCategorySettingJsonModel.DepositPercent` |
| Cancel full refund window | 15 minutes after deposit | `CancelOrderSetting.FullRefundWithinMinutes` |
| Cancel no-refund window | 7 days before rental | `CancelOrderSetting.NoRefundGreaterThanDays` |
| Cancel penalty | 30% of deposit | `PenaltyDepositPercent` |
| Commission cascade | ServiceItem → Owner → Category → System default | `CompletionFeePercentage` |
| Owner confirm timeout | 3 hours (business hours) | `HourOwner2Confirm` |
| Renter deposit timeout | 3 hours (business hours) | `HourCustomer2Deposit` |
| Business hours | 7:00 - 21:00 VN time | `RentalServiceCategorySettingJsonModel` |
| Auto-complete | 60 min after ToDate | `AutoCompleteOrder_AfterMinutes` |
| Early/Late hour fee | hours × rate × 1000 VND | `EarlyHourDeliveryFee`, `LateHourReturnFee` |
| ≥12h early/late | Counted as full day | `NumOfHourToBeOneDay = 12` |
| Min withdrawal | 2,000 VND | MB Bank integration |
| Daily wallet limit | 60,000,000 VND | `ConfigWalletType.DailyLimit` |
| Search radius | 30km default | `MaxDistance` |
| Insurance check | CoverageStartDate ≤ rental ≤ CoverageEndDate | `Vehicle_InsuranceInformation` |

## Configuration Cascade

```
SystemConfig (global defaults)
  → RentalServiceCategorySettingJsonModel (per category)
    → Vehicle_RentalSetting (per vehicle)
      → ServiceItem-level overrides (per rental item)
```
